thread:
jun: Rolling out release v3.0.0-rt across regions. Plan: US canary 3% -> EU canary 5% -> APAC warm-pool -> open. Change window 23:00-03:00 UTC. Rollback triggers: 5xx >2% sustained 3m OR p99 latency >1500ms. Pin model variant to q4f16-compat for cost profile. Release notes: https://redwood/release/v3.0.0 deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary kick: service=backend variant=v3.0.0-rt region=us slices=1/33 ts=3625001140 infra-bot: Preflight check: US hosted capacity healthy. EU dedicated pool low (2 GPUs spare) — recommend EU warm-pool spin before EU canary. APAC region has maintenance window at 01:30 UTC, keep APAC warm-only. tess: Noted re: EU. I'll request +4 GPUs to dedicated EU pool now and mark proc as high-priority. ops-lead: Dashboards ready. Watching p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, mem pressure, and GPU util. Alerts: 5xx >=2% -> #ops-alerts, p99 >=1500ms -> #ops-alerts. Also set transient alert for host OOMs. naomi: Pinning tokenizer service to 2.1.4 to avoid mismatch; adding to rollout manifest. deploy-bot: [deploybot] US canary health @6m: p99=980ms, 5xx=0.7%, gpu_util=68%, model_mem=74%. Status=GREEN. jun: Good. Proceed to US ramp to 10% over next 25m with 5m holds. EU warm-pool should be ready before EU canary start. infra-bot: EU warm-pool spin initiated (+4 GPUs). ETA ~11m. Also noticed config: default batch_size=64 for v3.0.0-rt — suggest 48 in US to reduce latency for short requests. mike: Can we change batch_size on-the-fly? We did hot-config before. tess: Yes, canary config override works. I'll lower batch_size to 48 for US canary slice 2 if p99 trends up. deploy-bot: [deploybot] US ramp to 10% start: slice=1->3/30 ts=3625001185 deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 2 health @4m: p99=1430ms, 5xx=1.1% -> approaching threshold ops-lead: Alerting: p99 creeping. Hold next ramp. Tess, apply batch_size override now. tess: Applying config: runtime.batch_size=48 for region=us variant=v3.0.0-rt ts=3625001210 deploy-bot: [deploybot] Re-eval @3m: p99=850ms, 5xx=0.6% -> trend improved, alert cleared naomi: Also enabling async fallback for long-prompt jobs to avoid blocking inference queue (fallback=max-async=100). Deployed.
infra-bot: Spun EU +4 GPUs, now 6 spare GPUs in EU pool. Ready for EU canary in 12m. jun: EU canary start at +14m if no regressions in US for 20m. APAC stays warm-standby until both stable 1h. deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU canary kick: service=backend variant=v3.0.0-rt region=eu slices=1/20 ts=3625001240 deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU 5m health: p99=720ms, 5xx=0.4%, gpu_mem=60% Status=GREEN mike: Observing a KV miss spike in EU at canary start (misses +12%). Could be cache keys hashed differently with tokenizer pin. naomi: Looking now. Pattern shows prefix mismatch for some routed requests. Enabling cache-prefill and key-normalizer v2 to smooth. deploy-bot: [deploybot] Config applied: cache.prefill=true, key_norm=v2 ts=3625001265 deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU recheck @2m: KV miss delta down to +2%, p99 stable ops-lead: EU holding at 5% for 30m. No infra alerts. Proceed to schedule US->30% ramp in 10m after hold window. jun: APAC: keep warm-pool at 25% and defer opening until US+EU stable for 1h. Also add a note in release notes about the batch_size tweak and tokenizer pin. tess: Added entry to release notes: "v3.0.0-rt: cost-optimized q4f16 model; tokenizer pinned 2.1.4; temporary batch_size override in US to mitigate p99 spikes; async fallback enabled for long jobs." Link: https://redwood/release/v3.0.0/notes deploy-bot: [deploybot] US ramp to 30% start: slices=4/30 ts=3625001290 deploy-bot: [deploybot] US health @3m: p99=1605ms, 5xx=2.3% -> ALERT fired to #ops-alerts (p99 and 5xx exceeded) ops-lead: Received alert. Pausing rollout. Initiate rollback checklist: 1) abort further ramps 2) pin region=us variant=v2.9.8-fallback 3) notify statuspage 4) investigate root cause. jun: Before full rollback, try immediate mitigation: increase runtime.num_workers by 20% to relieve queue pressure and reduce in-queue latency. If no improvement in 8m, roll back US to v2.9.8-fallback. tess: Applying quick scale: runtime.num_workers +20% for us ts=3625001298 deploy-bot: [deploybot] Re-eval @4m: p99=950ms, 5xx=0.9% -> recovered, alert cleared ops-lead: Good recovery. Keep US held at 30% for 30m and run postmortem if we see recurrence. No customer-facing rollback. Updating statuspage: "Partial rollout paused briefly for remediation; no customer impact." jun: Final plan: continue staggered ramp after holds. APAC to open only after US+EU stable for 1h. Add a follow-up to ops to run a load-profile test that reproduces the p99 spike. Thanks team :rocket:"
